text_blocks.snippet: If you test positive for COVID-19, the first step is to seek treatment, especially if you have serious symptoms like severe shortness of breath or chest pain. You should also isolate yourself to prevent further spread of the virus. Additionally, wear a mask to protect others and take precautions, such as informing your close contacts. Isolation is generally recommended for at least five days, counting from when symptoms started or from the date of the positive test if asymptomatic. You can end isolation if your symptoms are mild and improving or if you have been fever-free for 24 hours without medication. Even after ending isolation, continue wearing a mask for 10 days.
